title: Tahini and Banana Porridge with Maple and Sesame
changes_from_base: A mashed banana is cooked into the oats with cinnamon and a little cardamom, and each bowl is finished with tahini, sliced banana, maple syrup and toasted sesame instead of fresh blueberries.
summary: Creaminess from tahini and banana meets sweet maple and the pleasant crunch of toasted sesame in this warming bowl.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Put 480 ml milk, 85 g rolled oats, 1 mashed ripe banana, ¼ tsp ground cinnamon, ⅛ tsp ground cardamom (optional) and ⅛ tsp fine salt in a medium saucepan.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Bring to a simmer over medium heat.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Stir often for 5-7 min until the porridge becomes thick and creamy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Drizzle each with 2 tbsp tahini and 2 tbsp maple syrup.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with sliced banana and 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds.

tips: Use the ripest bananas you can find for maximum natural sweetness and smoother mashing.
Stir the tahini well before using to ensure the rich oils distribute evenly throughout.
Toast sesame seeds yourself just before serving for superior nuttiness.
storage: Serve immediately for best texture; leftover porridge keeps covered for 1 day in the fridge and reheats gently over low heat with a splash of milk. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
